intro.en: Two students meet at a language institute. One has studied Arabic for three years but cannot speak it well. Her friend gives her advice: memorise Quran and speak a lot.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein do talibaat ki guftagu hai. Ek ne teen saal Arabi padhi lekin bolna nahin aata. Dost use mashwara deti hai: Quran yaad karo aur zyada bolo.
intro.ar: طالِبَتانِ تَلْتَقِيانِ في مَعْهَدِ لُغَةٍ. إِحْداهُما دَرَسَتِ العَرَبِيَّةَ ثَلاثَ سَنَواتٍ وَلا تَتَكَلَّمُها جَيِّداً، فَتَنْصَحُها صَديقَتُها بِحِفْظِ القُرْآنِ وَكَثْرَةِ الكَلامِ.

dialogue.ar: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّكِ طالِبَةٌ جَديدَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: aʿtaqidu annaki ṭālibatun jadīdah
dialogue.en: I think you are a new student.
dialogue.ur: Mera khayal hai aap nayi talibah hain.

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، التَحَقْتُ بِالمَعْهَدِ هَذِهِ السَّنَةَ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, iltaḥaqtu bil-maʿhadi hādhihi s-sanah
dialogue.en: Yes, I joined the institute this year.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, maine is saal institute mein dakhila liya.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ دَرَسْتِ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ في بَلَدِكِ؟
dialogue.tr: hal darasti l-lughata l-ʿarabiyyah fī baladiki?
dialogue.en: Did you study Arabic in your country?
dialogue.ur: Kya aapne apne mulk mein Arabi padhi?

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ أَوَّلُ مَرَّةٍ أَدْرُسُ فيها العَرَبِيَّةَ.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi awwalu marratin adrusu fīhā l-ʿarabiyyah
dialogue.en: This is the first time I study Arabic.
dialogue.ur: Yeh pehli baar hai ke main Arabi padh rahi hoon.

dialogue.ar: أَنا دَرَسْتُ العَرَبِيَّةَ ثَلاثَ سَنَواتٍ في بَلَدي.
dialogue.tr: anā darastu l-ʿarabiyyah thalātha sanawātin fī baladī
dialogue.en: I studied Arabic for three years in my country.
dialogue.ur: Maine apne mulk mein teen saal Arabi padhi.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا تَدْرُسينَها مَرَّةً ثانِيَةً إِذَنْ؟
dialogue.tr: li-mādhā tadrusīnahā marratan thāniyatan idhan?
dialogue.en: Why are you studying it a second time, then?
dialogue.ur: Phir doobara kyun padh rahi hain?

dialogue.ar: في بَلَدي نَتَعَلَّمُ القِراءَةَ وَالقَواعِدَ وَالتَّرْجَمَةَ، وَلا نَتَعَلَّمُ الحَديثَ بِاللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: fī baladī nataʿallamu l-qirāʾah wal-qawāʿid wat-tarjamah, wa lā nataʿallamu l-ḥadītha bil-lughati l-ʿarabiyyah
dialogue.en: In my country we learn reading, grammar and translation, but we do not learn to speak Arabic.
dialogue.ur: Mere mulk mein hum parhna, qawaid aur tarjuma seekhte hain, Arabi bolna nahin seekhte.

dialogue.ar: وَلَكِنَّكِ تَتَحَدَّثينَ العَرَبِيَّةَ الآنَ جَيِّداً!
dialogue.tr: wa lākinnaki tataḥaddathīna l-ʿarabiyyah al-āna jayyidan
dialogue.en: But you speak Arabic well now!
dialogue.ur: Lekin aap to ab achhi Arabi bol rahi hain!

dialogue.ar: تَعَلَّمْتُ الحَديثَ بِاللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ هُنا. في المَعْهَدِ مُخْتَبَرٌ وَحاسوبٌ وَإِذاعَةٌ وَمَكْتَبَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: taʿallamtu l-ḥadītha bil-lughati l-ʿarabiyyati hunā. fil-maʿhadi mukhtabarun wa ḥāsūbun wa idhāʿatun wa maktabah
dialogue.en: I learned to speak Arabic here. The institute has a lab, a computer, a radio and a library.
dialogue.ur: Maine yahan Arabi bolna seekha. Institute mein lab, computer, radio aur library hai.

dialogue.ar: لا أَسْتَطيعُ نُطْقَ الأَصْواتِ: ق، ظ، ح جَيِّداً.
dialogue.tr: lā astaṭīʿu nuṭqa l-aṣwāt: qāf, ẓāʾ, ḥāʾ jayyidan
dialogue.en: I cannot pronounce the sounds ق، ظ، ح well.
dialogue.ur: Main ق، ظ، ح ki awazein achhi tarah nahin bol sakti.

dialogue.ar: هُناكَ تَدْريباتٌ صَوْتِيَّةٌ جَيِّدَةٌ في مُخْتَبَرِ اللُّغَةِ.
dialogue.tr: hunāka tadrībātun ṣawtiyyatun jayyidatun fī mukhtabari l-lughah
dialogue.en: There are good sound exercises in the language lab.
dialogue.ur: Language lab mein awaz ki achhi mashqein hain.

dialogue.ar: وَلا أَسْتَطيعُ التَّحَدُّثَ بِاللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ، وَلا أَفْهَمُ كَلامَ المُدَرِّسَةِ وَالطَّالِباتِ. أُريدُ أَنْ أَتَعَلَّمَ العَرَبِيَّةَ جَيِّداً. ماذا أَفْعَلُ؟!
dialogue.tr: wa lā astaṭīʿu t-taḥaddutha bil-lughati l-ʿarabiyyah, wa lā afhamu kalāma l-mudarrisati waṭ-ṭālibāt. urīdu an ataʿallama l-ʿarabiyyata jayyidan. mādhā afʿal?
dialogue.en: I cannot speak Arabic, nor understand the teacher and students. I want to learn Arabic well. What should I do?
dialogue.ur: Main Arabi bol nahin sakti, na ustaani aur talibaat ki baat samajhti hoon. Achhi Arabi seekhna chahti hoon. Kya karoon?

dialogue.ar: اِحْفَظي جُزْءاً مِنَ القُرآنِ الكَريمِ، وَبَعْضَ الأَحاديثِ النَّبَوِيَّةِ، وَتَحَدَّثي بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: iḥfaẓī juzʾan minal-qurʾāni l-karīm, wa baʿḍa l-aḥādīthi n-nabawiyyah, wa taḥaddathī bil-ʿarabiyyati kathīran
dialogue.en: Memorise a part of the Noble Quran and some Prophetic hadiths, and speak Arabic a lot.
dialogue.ur: Quran-e-Kareem ka ek hissa aur kuch Ahadees yaad karein, aur Arabi mein khoob baat karein.

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ نَصيحَةٌ مُفيدَةٌ، سَأَتَّبِعُها، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi naṣīḥatun mufīdah, sa-attabiʿuhā, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: This is useful advice; I will follow it, God willing.
dialogue.ur: Yeh mufeed nasihat hai, inshaAllah main is par amal karungi.

dialogue.ar: إِذَنْ سَتَتَعَلَّمينَ العَرَبِيَّةَ جَيِّداً.
dialogue.tr: idhan satataʿallamīna l-ʿarabiyyata jayyidan
dialogue.en: Then you will learn Arabic well.
dialogue.ur: To aap Arabi achhi tarah seekh jayengi.

q.ur: «مَعْهَد» ka matlab kya hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَكاناً نَتَعَلَّمُ فيهِ اللُّغَةَ؟

q.en: The second student advises her to memorise:
q.ur: Doosri talibah use kya yaad karne ka mashwara deti hai?
«نَصيحَةٌ مُفيدَةٌ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: How many years did she study Arabic in her country?
q.ur: Usne apne mulk mein kitne saal Arabi padhi?
q.ar: كَمْ سَنَةً دَرَسَتِ الطّالِبَةُ العَرَبِيَّةَ في بَلَدِها؟

title.en: The connecting and the cutting hamzah

intro.en: The cutting hamzah (همزة القطع) is pronounced at the start of speech and also when joined to a word before it. The connecting hamzah (همزة الوصل) is pronounced only at the start, and is dropped when joined. Example: اِجْلِسْ (start) but وَاجْلِسْ (joined: the hamzah disappears).
intro.ur: Hamzat-ul-qat shuru mein bhi aur beech mein bhi bolta hai. Hamzat-ul-wasl sirf shuru mein bolta hai, jab kisi lafz se mil jaye to gir jata hai. Misal: اِجْلِسْ lekin وَاجْلِسْ.
intro.ar: هَمْزَةُ القَطْعِ تُنْطَقُ في أَوَّلِ الكَلامِ وَفي وَسَطِهِ. أَمّا هَمْزَةُ الوَصْلِ فَتُنْطَقُ في أَوَّلِ الكَلامِ فَقَط وَتَسْقُطُ إِذا اتَّصَلَتْ بِما قَبْلَها. مِثالٌ: اِجْلِسْ، وَلَكِنْ: وَاجْلِسْ.

q.en: Which hamzah is NOT pronounced when joined to the word before it?
q.ur: Pichhle lafz se milne par kaun sa hamzah nahin bola jata?
q.ar: أَيُّ هَمْزَةٍ لا تُنْطَقُ إِذا اتَّصَلَتْ بِالكَلِمَةِ قَبْلَها؟

q.ur: «أَكْتُبُ» mein hamzah kaisa hai?
«اِسْتَمِعْ» mein hamzah kaisa hai?
«أَجْلِسُ» kis se shuru hota hai?

intro.en: الَّذي (alladhī) joins a sentence to a masculine singular noun, and الَّتي (allatī) to a feminine singular noun. It means 'who / which / that'. Example: رَجَعَ الطَّالِبُ الَّذي سافَرَ – the student who travelled came back.
intro.ur: الَّذي mard/muzakkar wahid ke liye aur الَّتي aurat/muannas wahid ke liye aata hai. Matlab: jo / jis ne. Misal: رَجَعَ الطَّالِبُ الَّذي سافَرَ – woh talib-e-ilm laut aaya jo safar par gaya tha.
intro.ar: «الَّذي» لِلْمُفْرَدِ المُذَكَّرِ وَ«الَّتي» لِلْمُفْرَدِ المُؤَنَّثِ، وَهُما يَرْبِطانِ الجُمْلَةَ بِالاسْمِ قَبْلَهُما. مِثالٌ: رَجَعَ الطّالِبُ الَّذي سافَرَ.

q.en: Which relative noun is used with a feminine singular noun?
q.ur: Muannas wahid ke saath kaun sa ism-e-mausool aata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ اسْمٍ مَوْصولٍ نَسْتَعْمِلُهُ مَعَ المُفْرَدِ المُؤَنَّثِ؟

q.ur: Mukammal karein: عادَتِ الطَّالِبَةُ ___ سافَرَتْ.

q.en: Complete: هَذا هُوَ الرَّجُلُ ___ يُحِبُّ دينَهُ.
q.ur: Mukammal karein: هَذا هُوَ الرَّجُلُ ___ يُحِبُّ دينَهُ.
q.ar: أَكْمِلْ: هَذا هُوَ الرَّجُلُ ___ يُحِبُّ دينَهُ.

q.en: What comes after الَّذي and الَّتي?
q.ur: الَّذي aur الَّتي ke baad kya aata hai?

intro.en: Listen to a dialogue and mark each sentence right or wrong. Then practise asking a classmate questions about languages: your first language, how many languages you speak, and why you are learning Arabic.
intro.ur: Guftagu sun kar har jumle ko sahi ya ghalat batayein. Phir apne sathi se zubanon ke bare mein sawal poochhein: aap ki pehli zubaan, kitni zubanein bolte hain, Arabi kyun seekh rahe hain.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى حِوارٍ وَحَدِّدْ صَوابَ كُلِّ جُمْلَةٍ أَوْ خَطَأَها. ثُمَّ اسْأَلْ زَميلَكَ عَنِ اللُّغاتِ: لُغَتِهِ الأولى، وَعَدَدِ اللُّغاتِ الَّتي يَتَكَلَّمُها، وَسَبَبِ تَعَلُّمِهِ العَرَبِيَّةَ.

q.en: How do you ask 'What is your first language?'
q.ur: «Aap ki pehli zubaan kya hai?» kaise poochhenge?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ عَنِ اللُّغَةِ الأولى لِصَديقِكَ؟

q.ur: «لِماذا تَتَعَلَّمُ العَرَبِيَّةَ؟» kya poochta hai?
«الأُمّ» ka matlab:
«مَتى بَدَأْتَ؟» ka matlab:

intro.en: This reading is about how Arabic began among the tribes of Arabia, how the Quran was revealed in Fusha (classical) Arabic, and how Arabic influenced the languages of Muslim peoples such as Persian, Urdu and Swahili.
intro.ur: Is parhne mein bataya gaya hai ke Arabi Jazeera-e-Arab mein kaise shuru hui, Quran Fusha Arabi mein nazil hua, aur Arabi ne Farsi, Urdu aur Swahili jaisi zubanon par asar dala.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنْ نَشْأَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ بَيْنَ قَبائِلِ جَزيرَةِ العَرَبِ، وَنُزولِ القُرْآنِ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ الفُصْحى، وَأَثَرِها في لُغاتِ الشُّعوبِ المُسْلِمَةِ كَالفارِسِيَّةِ وَالأُرْدِيَّةِ وَالسّواحِلِيَّةِ.

dialogue.ar: نَشَأَتِ اللُّغَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ في جَزيرَةِ العَرَبِ قَبْلَ الإِسْلامِ، وَكانَ العَرَبُ قَبائِلَ مُتَفَرِّقَةً.
dialogue.tr: nashaʾati l-lughatu l-ʿarabiyyah fī jazīrati l-ʿarab qabla l-islām, wa kāna l-ʿarabu qabāʾila mutafarriqah
dialogue.en: Arabic arose in the Arabian Peninsula before Islam, and the Arabs were scattered tribes.
dialogue.ur: Arabi Islam se pehle Jazeera-e-Arab mein shuru hui, aur Arab alag alag qabeelon mein the.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَتْ لِلْعَرَبِ لُغَةٌ مُشْتَرَكَةٌ هِيَ اللُّغَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ الفَصيحَةُ؛ لُغَةُ الشِّعْرِ وَالخَطابَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa kānat lil-ʿarabi lughatun mushtarakah hiya l-lughatu l-ʿarabiyyatu l-faṣīḥah; lughatu sh-shiʿri wal-khaṭābah
dialogue.en: The Arabs had a common language, Fusha Arabic: the language of poetry and speech-making.
dialogue.ur: Arabon ki ek mushtarak zubaan thi, Fusha Arabi: shayari aur khitabat ki zubaan.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ جاءَ الإِسْلامُ، وَأَنْزَلَ اللهُ القُرآنَ الكَريمَ بِاللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ الفَصيحَةِ.
dialogue.tr: thumma jāʾa l-islām, wa anzala llāhu l-qurʾāna l-karīma bil-lughati l-ʿarabiyyati l-faṣīḥah
dialogue.en: Then Islam came, and Allah revealed the Noble Quran in Fusha Arabic.
dialogue.ur: Phir Islam aaya, aur Allah ne Quran-e-Kareem Fusha Arabi mein nazil farmaya.

dialogue.ar: قالَ اللهُ تَعالى: ﴿إِنَّا أَنْزَلْناهُ قُرْآناً عَرَبِيّاً لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلونَ﴾ [يوسف: ٢]
dialogue.tr: qāla llāhu taʿālā: innā anzalnāhu qurʾānan ʿarabiyyan laʿallakum taʿqilūn (Yūsuf: 2)
dialogue.en: Allah the Most High said: We have sent it down as an Arabic Quran so that you may understand. (Yusuf: 2)
dialogue.ur: Allah Taala ne farmaya: Hum ne ise Arabi Quran banakar utara taake tum samjho. (Yusuf: 2)

dialogue.ar: أَعْطى القُرآنُ الكَريمُ بَعْضَ الأَلْفاظِ العَرَبِيَّةِ القَديمَةِ مَعانِيَ جَديدَةً، وَجاءَ بِأَساليبَ جَديدَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: aʿṭā l-qurʾānu l-karīmu baʿḍa l-alfāẓi l-ʿarabiyyati l-qadīmati maʿāniya jadīdah, wa jāʾa bi-asālība jadīdah
dialogue.en: The Quran gave some old Arabic words new meanings and came with new styles.
dialogue.ur: Quran ne kuch purane Arabi alfaaz ko naye maani diye aur naye usloob pesh kiye.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ القُرآنُ سَبَباً في نَشْأَةِ عُلومِ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ: كَالنَّحْوِ وَالصَّرْفِ وَالبَلاغَةِ، وَالعُلومِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ: كَعِلْمِ التَّفْسيرِ وَالحَديثِ وَالفِقْهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna l-qurʾānu sababan fī nashʾati ʿulūmi l-lughati l-ʿarabiyyah: kan-naḥwi waṣ-ṣarfi wal-balāghah, wal-ʿulūmi l-islāmiyyah: kaʿilmi t-tafsīri wal-ḥadīthi wal-fiqh
dialogue.en: The Quran was a cause of the rise of the Arabic-language sciences (grammar, morphology, rhetoric) and the Islamic sciences (tafsir, hadith, fiqh).
dialogue.ur: Quran Arabi ke ulum (nahw, sarf, balaghat) aur Islami ulum (tafseer, hadees, fiqh) ke paida hone ka sabab bana.

dialogue.ar: أَثَّرَتِ اللُّغَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ في لُغاتِ الشُّعوبِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ كَالفارِسِيَّةِ وَالأُرْدِيَّةِ وَالسَّواحِلِيَّةِ، فَاقْتَرَضَتْها كَثيراً مِنَ الأَلْفاظِ، وَكُتِبَ كَثيرٌ مِنْ تِلْكَ اللُّغاتِ بِالحَرْفِ العَرَبِيِّ.
dialogue.tr: aththarati l-lughatu l-ʿarabiyyah fī lughāti sh-shuʿūbi l-islāmiyyah kal-fārisiyyah wal-urdiyyah was-sawāḥiliyyah, fa-aqtaraḍathā kathīran minal-alfāẓ, wa kutiba kathīrun min tilka l-lughāti bil-ḥarfi l-ʿarabī
dialogue.en: Arabic influenced the languages of Muslim peoples such as Persian, Urdu and Swahili; they borrowed many words, and many were written in the Arabic script.
dialogue.ur: Arabi ne Farsi, Urdu aur Swahili jaisi zubanon par asar dala; unhon ne bohat se alfaaz liye aur kai Arabi rasmulkhat mein likhi gayin.

dialogue.ar: وَاقْتَرَضَتْ لُغاتٌ أُخْرى بَعْضَ الأَلْفاظِ العَرَبِيَّةِ، مِثْلُ: الإِنْجِليزِيَّةِ وَالفَرَنْسِيَّةِ وَالإِسْبانِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: waqtaraḍat lughātun ukhrā baʿḍa l-alfāẓi l-ʿarabiyyah, mithlu: al-injilīziyyah wal-faransiyyah wal-isbāniyyah
dialogue.en: Other languages also borrowed some Arabic words, like English, French and Spanish.
dialogue.ur: Doosri zubanon ne bhi kuch Arabi alfaaz liye, jaise Angrezi, Fransisi aur Hispani.

q.en: In which language was the Quran revealed?
q.ur: Quran kis zubaan mein nazil hua?
Arabi zubaan kahan shuru hui?

q.en: Which is one of the Arabic-language sciences?
q.ur: Arabi zubaan ke ulum mein se kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيٌّ مِمّا يَأْتي مِنْ عُلومِ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ؟

q.en: Which language borrowed words from Arabic?
q.ur: Kis zubaan ne Arabi se alfaaz liye?
q.ar: أَيُّ لُغَةٍ اقْتَبَسَتْ كَلِماتٍ مِنَ العَرَبِيَّةِ؟

intro.en: كانَ is an incomplete past verb. It enters a noun sentence: the subject stays raised and is now called its اسْم (ism), and the predicate becomes accusative and is called its خَبَر (khabar). Its sisters: صارَ، لَيْسَ، أَصْبَحَ، ظَلَّ، ما زالَ. Example: كانَ العَرَبُ قَبائِلَ – the Arabs were tribes.
intro.ur: كانَ ek naqis fe'l hai jo jumla ismiya par aata hai: mubtada marfoo rehta hai (ism kaana) aur khabar mansoob ho jati hai (khabar kaana). Behnein: صارَ، لَيْسَ، أَصْبَحَ، ظَلَّ، ما زالَ. Misal: كانَ العَرَبُ قَبائِلَ.
intro.ar: «كانَ» فِعْلٌ ناقِصٌ يَدْخُلُ عَلى الجُمْلَةِ الاسْمِيَّةِ، فَيَبْقى المُبْتَدَأُ مَرْفوعاً وَيُسَمّى اسْمَها، وَيَصيرُ الخَبَرُ مَنْصوباً وَيُسَمّى خَبَرَها. مِنْ أَخَواتِها: صارَ، لَيْسَ، أَصْبَحَ، ظَلَّ، ما زالَ. مِثالٌ: كانَ العَرَبُ قَبائِلَ.

q.en: The subject after كانَ is called:
q.ur: كانَ ke baad mubtada ko kya kehte hain?

q.en: Which is NOT a sister of كانَ?
q.ur: Inmein se kaana ki behan kaun si nahin?

q.en: The khabar of كانَ is in which case?
q.ur: Khabar-e-kaana kis halat mein hota hai?
q.ar: خَبَرُ «كانَ» يَكونُ في أَيِّ حالَةٍ إِعْرابِيَّةٍ؟

q.en: Choose the correct form: صارَ الجَوُّ ___
q.ur: Durust shakl chunein: صارَ الجَوُّ ___
«ما زالَ» ka matlab:

intro.en: Two men, Sharif and Haroon, meet and talk about where they are travelling to study. Notice the polite goodbyes at the end: مَعَ السَّلامَةِ and في أَمانِ اللهِ.
intro.ur: Sharif aur Haroon ki mulaqat hoti hai aur woh batate hain ke ilm ke liye kahan ja rahe hain. Aakhir mein alvida ke adaab dekhein: مَعَ السَّلامَةِ aur في أَمانِ اللهِ.
intro.ar: رَجُلانِ، شَريفٌ وَهارونُ، يَلْتَقِيانِ وَيَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنِ المَكانِ الَّذي يُسافِرانِ إِلَيْهِ لِلدِّراسَةِ. اِنْتَبِهْ إِلى عِباراتِ الوَداعِ في آخِرِ الحِوارِ: مَعَ السَّلامَةِ وَفي أَمانِ اللهِ.

dialogue.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: as-salāmu ʿalaykum
dialogue.en: Peace be upon you.
dialogue.ur: Aap par salamati ho.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلامُ.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿalaykumu s-salām
dialogue.en: And upon you be peace.
dialogue.ur: Aur aap par bhi salamati ho.

dialogue.ar: إِلى أَيْنَ أَنْتَ مُسافِرٌ؟
dialogue.tr: ilā ayna anta musāfir?
dialogue.en: Where are you travelling to?
dialogue.ur: Aap kahan safar kar rahe hain?

dialogue.ar: أَنا مُسافِرٌ إِلى الرِّياضِ، سَأَلْتَحِقُ بِجامِعَةِ الإِمامِ، كُلِّيَّةِ الشَّريعَةِ. أُريدُ التَّخَصُّصَ في الدِّراساتِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: anā musāfirun ilā r-riyāḍ, sa-altaḥiqu bi-jāmiʿati l-imām, kulliyyati sh-sharīʿah. urīdu t-takhaṣṣuṣa fid-dirāsāti l-islāmiyyah
dialogue.en: I am travelling to Riyadh. I will join Imam University, the College of Sharia. I want to specialise in Islamic studies.
dialogue.ur: Main Riyadh ja raha hoon. Jamia al-Imam ki kulliyat-ush-shariah mein dakhila loonga. Islami ulum mein takhassus chahta hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَلَكِنَّكَ تَعْرِفُ الإِسْلامَ جَيِّداً.
dialogue.tr: wa lākinnaka taʿrifu l-islāma jayyidan
dialogue.en: But you know Islam well.
dialogue.ur: Lekin aap to Islam achhi tarah jaante hain.

dialogue.ar: دَرَسْتُ الإِسْلامَ بِاللُّغَةِ الأُرْدِيَّةِ، وَهَذا لا يَكْفي. يَجِبُ أَنْ أَدْرُسَ الإِسْلامَ بِاللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ؛ لِأَنَّها لُغَةُ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ، وَلا يُفْهَمُ القُرْآنُ إِلّا بِها.
dialogue.tr: darastu l-islāma bil-lughati l-urdiyyah, wa hādhā lā yakfī. yajibu an adrusa l-islāma bil-lughati l-ʿarabiyyah; li-annahā lughatu l-qurʾāni l-karīm, wa lā yufhamu l-qurʾānu illā bihā
dialogue.en: I studied Islam in Urdu, and this is not enough. I must study Islam in Arabic, because it is the language of the Noble Quran, and the Quran is understood only through it.
dialogue.ur: Maine Islam Urdu mein parha, yeh kaafi nahin. Mujhe Islam Arabi mein parhna chahiye, kyunke yeh Quran ki zubaan hai.

dialogue.ar: أَنا مُسافِرٌ إِلى القاهِرَةِ. سَوْفَ أَلْتَحِقُ بِجامِعَةِ القاهِرَةِ، كُلِّيَّةِ الآدابِ.
dialogue.tr: anā musāfirun ilā l-qāhirah. sawfa altaḥiqu bi-jāmiʿati l-qāhirah, kulliyyati l-ādāb
dialogue.en: I am travelling to Cairo. I will join Cairo University, the College of Arts.
dialogue.ur: Main Qahira ja raha hoon. Jamia Qahira ki kulliyat-ul-adab mein dakhila loonga.

dialogue.ar: ماذا سَتَدْرُسُ في كُلِّيَّةِ الآدابِ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā satadrusu fī kulliyyati l-ādāb?
dialogue.en: What will you study in the College of Arts?
dialogue.ur: Kulliyat-ul-adab mein kya parhenge?

dialogue.ar: أُريدُ التَّخَصُّصَ في عُلومِ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ؛ النَّحْوِ وَالصَّرْفِ وَالبَلاغَةِ.
dialogue.tr: urīdu t-takhaṣṣuṣa fī ʿulūmi l-lughati l-ʿarabiyyah; an-naḥwi waṣ-ṣarfi wal-balāghah
dialogue.en: I want to specialise in the Arabic-language sciences: grammar, morphology and rhetoric.
dialogue.ur: Main Arabi zubaan ke ulum mein takhassus karna chahta hoon: nahw, sarf aur balaghat.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا تُريدُ التَّخَصُّصَ في عُلومِ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ؟
dialogue.tr: li-mādhā turīdu t-takhaṣṣuṣa fī ʿulūmi l-lughati l-ʿarabiyyah?
dialogue.en: Why do you want to specialise in the Arabic-language sciences?
dialogue.ur: Arabi ke ulum mein takhassus kyun karna chahte hain?

dialogue.ar: سَأَكونُ مُدَرِّساً لِلُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ في جامِعَةِ إِسْلام آباد، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ، وَيَجِبُ أَنْ أَعْرِفَ هَذِهِ اللُّغَةَ جَيِّداً.
dialogue.tr: sa-akūnu mudarrisan lil-lughati l-ʿarabiyyah fī jāmiʿati islām ābād, in shāʾa llāh, wa yajibu an aʿrifa hādhihi l-lughata jayyidan
dialogue.en: I will be a teacher of Arabic at Islamabad University, God willing, and I must know this language well.
dialogue.ur: InshaAllah main Islamabad University mein Arabi ka ustaad banunga, aur mujhe yeh zubaan achhi tarah aani chahiye.

dialogue.ar: عَفْواً، هَذا هُوَ النِّداءُ الأَخيرُ لِطائِرَةِ الرِّياضِ. مَعَ السَّلامَةِ.
dialogue.tr: ʿafwan, hādhā huwa n-nidāʾu l-akhīr li-ṭāʾirati r-riyāḍ. maʿa s-salāmah
dialogue.en: Excuse me, this is the last call for the Riyadh plane. Goodbye.
dialogue.ur: Maaf kijiye, yeh Riyadh ki flight ka aakhri elaan hai. Khuda hafiz.

dialogue.ar: في أَمانِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: fī amāni llāh
dialogue.en: In Allah's protection.
dialogue.ur: Allah ki hifazat mein.

vocab.en: may Allah reward you with good

q.en: Where is Haroon travelling to study?
q.ur: Haroon parhne ke liye kahan ja raha hai?

q.en: Which college will Sharif join in Cairo?
q.ur: Sharif Qahira mein kaun si kulliyah mein jayega?
q.ar: إِلى أَيِّ كُلِّيَّةٍ سَيَلْتَحِقُ شَريفٌ في القاهِرَةِ؟

q.ur: «في أَمانِ اللهِ» kab kaha jata hai?
«عَفْواً» kis ke jawab mein kaha jata hai?

intro.en: Four letters ( أ ن ي ت ) are put before a verb to make the present tense: أ for 'I', ن for 'we', ي for 'he', ت for 'you / she'. Example: حَضَرَ becomes أَحْضُرُ (I attend), نَحْضُرُ (we attend), يَحْضُرُ (he attends), تَحْضُرُ (you / she attends).
intro.ur: Fe'l-e-muzare banane ke liye chaar huroof (أ ن ي ت) fe'l ke shuru mein lagte hain: أ = main, ن = hum, ي = woh (mard), ت = tum / woh (aurat). Misal: حَضَرَ se أَحْضُرُ، نَحْضُرُ، يَحْضُرُ، تَحْضُرُ.
intro.ar: أَرْبَعَةُ أَحْرُفٍ (أ ن ي ت) نَضَعُها قَبْلَ الفِعْلِ لِنَصْنَعَ المُضارِعَ: الهَمْزَةُ لِلمُتَكَلِّمِ، وَالنُّونُ لِلْمُتَكَلِّمينَ، وَالياءُ لِلْغائِبِ، وَالتّاءُ لِلْمُخاطَبِ أَوِ الغائِبَةِ. مِثالٌ: حَضَرَ ← أَحْضُرُ، نَحْضُرُ، يَحْضُرُ، تَحْضُرُ.

q.en: Which prefix means 'we' in the present tense?
q.ur: Muzare mein «hum» ke liye kaun sa harf hai?
عَرَفَ ka «main» wala muzare:

q.en: Present tense for «هُوَ» uses the prefix:
q.ur: «هُوَ» ke liye muzare ka harf:
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ نَضَعُهُ قَبْلَ المُضارِعِ لِلضَّميرِ «هُوَ»؟

q.ur: «تَحْضُرُ» kis ke liye aa sakta hai?

intro.en: Listen to a text about Rashida, a student who comes to Saudi Arabia to study Islam in Arabic. Then talk with a classmate about borrowed words and what you want to do.
intro.ur: Rashida ka matn suniye jo Islam ko Arabi mein parhne Saudi Arabia aati hai. Phir sathi ke saath udhaar liye gaye alfaaz aur apne iraadon par baat karein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى نَصٍّ عَنْ راشِدَةَ، طالِبَةٍ جاءَتْ إِلى المَمْلَكَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ السُّعودِيَّةِ لِدِراسَةِ الإِسْلامِ بِاللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ. ثُمَّ تَحَدَّثْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَنِ الكَلِماتِ المُقْتَرَضَةِ وَعَمّا تُريدُ أَنْ تَفْعَلَ.

q.en: How do you ask 'Did your language borrow words from Arabic?'
q.ur: «Kya aap ki zubaan ne Arabi se alfaaz liye?» kaise poochhenge?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ عَمّا اقْتَرَضَتْهُ لُغَتُكَ مِنَ العَرَبِيَّةِ؟

options: هَلِ اقْتَرَضَتْ لُغَتُكَ أَلْفاظاً مِنَ العَرَبِيَّةِ؟

q.ur: «تُريدُ السَّفَرَ إِلى بَلَدٍ عَرَبِيٍّ» ka matlab:
q.ar: ما مَعْنى «تُريدُ السَّفَرَ إِلى بَلَدٍ عَرَبِيٍّ»؟

options: You want to travel to an Arab country.
You want to study at home.
You want to buy a book.
You do not want to travel.
options_ar: تَرْغَبُ في السَّفَرِ إِلى بَلَدٍ عَرَبِيٍّ.

q.ur: «لُغَةُ القُرْآنِ» kya hai?
«تُريدُ التَّخَصُّصَ» ka matlab:

intro.en: A reading about Arabic as a world language: in the Abbasid age it was the language of science and civilization; later the dialects grew; today Arabic is again a world language and an official language of the United Nations.
intro.ur: Is parhne mein Arabi ko aalmi zubaan ke taur par bataya gaya hai: Abbasi daur mein yeh ilm aur tehzeeb ki zubaan thi, baad mein lehjay barhe, aur aaj yeh phir aalmi zubaan hai aur UN ki sarkari zubanon mein se hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ العَرَبِيَّةِ لُغَةً عالَمِيَّةً: كانَتْ في العَصْرِ العَبّاسِيِّ لُغَةَ العِلْمِ وَالحَضارَةِ، ثُمَّ كَثُرَتِ اللَّهَجاتُ، وَهِيَ اليَوْمَ لُغَةٌ عالَمِيَّةٌ وَلُغَةٌ رَسْمِيَّةٌ في هَيْئَةِ الأُمَمِ المُتَّحِدَةِ.

dialogue.ar: كانَتِ اللُّغَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ لُغَةً عالَمِيَّةً في العَصْرِ العَبّاسِيِّ، الَّذي ازْدَهَرَتْ فيهِ الحَضارَةُ الإِسْلامِيَّةُ.
dialogue.tr: kānati l-lughatu l-ʿarabiyyatu lughatan ʿālamiyyatan fil-ʿaṣri l-ʿabbāsī, alladhī izdaharat fīhi l-ḥaḍāratu l-islāmiyyah
dialogue.en: Arabic was a world language in the Abbasid era, in which Islamic civilization flourished.
dialogue.ur: Abbasi daur mein Arabi aalmi zubaan thi, jis mein Islami tehzeeb phali phooli.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَتِ العَرَبِيَّةُ لُغَةَ تِلْكَ الحَضارَةِ، الَّتي تُرْجِمَتْ إِلَيْها الكُتُبُ مِنَ اليونانِيَّةِ وَالفارِسِيَّةِ، وَأَلَّفَ بِها العُلَماءُ في الطِّبِّ وَالهَنْدَسَةِ وَالرِّياضِيّاتِ وَالعُلومِ.
dialogue.tr: wa kānati l-ʿarabiyyatu lughata tilka l-ḥaḍārah, allatī turjimat ilayhā l-kutubu minal-yūnāniyyati wal-fārisiyyah, wa allafa bihā l-ʿulamāʾu fiṭ-ṭibbi wal-handasati war-riyāḍiyyāti wal-ʿulūm
dialogue.en: Arabic was the language of that civilization; books were translated into it from Greek and Persian, and scholars wrote in it on medicine, engineering, mathematics and the sciences.
dialogue.ur: Arabi us tehzeeb ki zubaan thi; Yunani aur Farsi se kitabon ka tarjuma hua, aur ulama ne tib, handasa, riyazi aur ulum par likha.

dialogue.ar: وَحَمَلَتِ اللُّغَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ تِلْكَ العُلومَ إِلى أُوروبّا، فَكانَتْ أَساسَ الحَضارَةِ الغَرْبِيَّةِ الحَديثَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ḥamalati l-lughatu l-ʿarabiyyatu tilka l-ʿulūma ilā ūrūbbā, fa-kānat asāsa l-ḥaḍārati l-gharbiyyati l-ḥadīthah
dialogue.en: Arabic carried those sciences to Europe, and became the base of modern Western civilization.
dialogue.ur: Arabi ne yeh ulum Europe tak pohanchaye aur jadeed Maghribi tehzeeb ki buniyad bani.

dialogue.ar: مَرَّتْ بِالعَرَبِ عُصورٌ مِنَ الضَّعْفِ، ابْتَعَدوا فيها عَنْ دينِهِمْ، وَهَجَروا اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ الفَصيحَةَ، وَاسْتَعْمَلوا اللَّهَجاتِ.
dialogue.tr: marrat bil-ʿarabi ʿuṣūrun minaḍ-ḍaʿf, ibtaʿadū fīhā ʿan dīnihim, wa hajarū l-lughata l-ʿarabiyyata l-faṣīḥah, wastaʿmalū l-lahajāt
dialogue.en: The Arabs passed through ages of weakness, in which they drifted from their religion, abandoned Fusha Arabic and used dialects.
dialogue.ur: Arabon par kamzori ke daur aaye, jin mein woh apne deen se door hue, Fusha Arabi chhodi aur lehjay istemal kiye.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ جاءَ الاسْتِعْمارُ، فَحارَبَ الثَّقافَةَ الإِسْلامِيَّةَ وَاللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ الفَصيحَةَ، وَشَجَّعَ اللَّهَجاتِ.
dialogue.tr: thumma jāʾa l-istiʿmār, fa-ḥāraba th-thaqāfata l-islāmiyyata wal-lughata l-ʿarabiyyata l-faṣīḥah, wa shajjaʿa l-lahajāt
dialogue.en: Then colonialism came; it fought Islamic culture and Fusha Arabic, and encouraged dialects.
dialogue.ur: Phir istemar aaya; usne Islami saqafat aur Fusha Arabi se jang ki aur lehjon ko barhawa diya.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ أَدّى هَذا إِلى تَفَرُّقِ العَرَبِ وَبُعْدِ بَعْضِهِمْ عَنْ بَعْضٍ؛ بِحَيْثُ إِذا سافَرَ العَرَبِيُّ مِنْ بَلَدِهِ إِلى بَلَدٍ عَرَبِيٍّ آخَرَ، وَجَدَ بَعْضَ الصُّعوبَةِ في الاتِّصالِ بِأَهْلِ ذَلِكَ البَلَدِ.
dialogue.tr: wa qad addā hādhā ilā tafarruqi l-ʿarab wa buʿdi baʿḍihim ʿan baʿḍ; bi-ḥaythu idhā sāfara l-ʿarabiyyu min baladihi ilā baladin ʿarabiyyin ākhar, wajada baʿḍa ṣ-ṣuʿūbati fil-ittiṣāl
dialogue.en: This led to the Arabs dividing and growing apart, so that when an Arab travels to another Arab country he finds some difficulty communicating with its people.
dialogue.ur: Is se Arab bikhar gaye aur ek doosre se door ho gaye, yahan tak ke jab ek Arab doosre Arab mulk jata hai to baat cheet mein kuch mushkil hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: اخْتَلَفَ الأَمْرُ اليَوْمَ، فَضَعُفَتِ اللَّهَجاتُ، وَقَوِيَتِ اللُّغَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ الفَصيحَةُ؛ بِسَبَبِ التَّعْليمِ وَوَسائِلِ الاتِّصالِ الحَديثَةِ.
dialogue.tr: ikhtalafa l-amru l-yawm, fa-ḍaʿufati l-lahajāt, wa qawiyati l-lughatu l-ʿarabiyyatu l-faṣīḥah; bi-sababi t-taʿlīmi wa wasāʾili l-ittiṣāli l-ḥadīthah
dialogue.en: Today it is different: dialects have weakened and Fusha Arabic has grown stronger, because of education and modern means of communication.
dialogue.ur: Aaj haal mukhtalif hai: lehjay kamzor hue aur Fusha Arabi mazboot hui, taleem aur jadeed zarai-e-rabta ki wajah se.

dialogue.ar: وَأَصْبَحَتِ العَرَبِيَّةُ لُغَةً عالَمِيَّةً مَرَّةً ثانِيَةً، كَالإِنْجِليزِيَّةِ وَالفَرَنْسِيَّةِ وَالإِسْبانِيَّةِ. فَهِيَ إِحْدى اللُّغاتِ الرَّسْمِيَّةِ في هَيْئَةِ الأُمَمِ المُتَّحِدَةِ، وَهِيَ اللُّغَةُ السّادِسَةُ في العالَمِ، يَتَحَدَّثُ بِها أَكْثَرُ مِنْ ٢٠٠ مِلْيون عَرَبِيٍّ، وَيُؤَدّي العِباداتِ بِها أَكْثَرُ مِنْ مِلْيارِ مُسْلِمٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa aṣbaḥati l-ʿarabiyyatu lughatan ʿālamiyyatan marratan thāniyah, kal-injilīziyyati wal-faransiyyati wal-isbāniyyah. fahiya iḥdā l-lughāti r-rasmiyyati fī hayʾati l-umami l-muttaḥidah, wa hiya l-lughatu s-sādisatu fil-ʿālam, yataḥaddathu bihā aktharu min mi'atayi milyūn ʿarabī, wa yuaddī l-ʿibādāti bihā aktharu min milyāri muslim
dialogue.en: Arabic has again become a world language like English, French and Spanish. It is one of the official languages of the United Nations and the sixth language in the world; more than 200 million Arabs speak it and more than a billion Muslims perform worship in it.
dialogue.ur: Arabi dobara aalmi zubaan ban gayi. Yeh UN ki sarkari zubanon mein se hai, duniya ki chhatti zubaan hai; 200 million se zyada Arab ise bolte hain aur ek arab se zyada Musalman ibadat is mein karte hain.

q.en: In which era was Arabic a world language?
q.ur: Arabi kis daur mein aalmi zubaan thi?
q.ar: في أَيِّ عَصْرٍ كانَتِ العَرَبِيَّةُ لُغَةً عالَمِيَّةً؟

q.en: Arabic is the ___ language in the world (by this text).

intro.en: The na't (adjective) is a word that describes the noun before it, and it follows that noun in its ending (i'rab). Example: طالِبَةٌ جَديدَةٌ – a new student; القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ – the Noble Quran.
intro.ur: Na't woh lafz hai jo pichhle ism ki sifat bayan karta hai aur is ke i'rab mein uski pairvi karta hai. Misal: طالِبَةٌ جَديدَةٌ – nayi talibah; القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ – Quran-e-Kareem.
intro.ar: النَّعْتُ (الصِّفَةُ) كَلِمَةٌ تَصِفُ الاسْمَ قَبْلَها وَتَتْبَعُهُ في إِعْرابِهِ. مِثالٌ: طالِبَةٌ جَديدَةٌ، القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ.

q.ur: «طالِبَةٌ جَديدَةٌ» mein sifat kaun si hai?
«الأَحاديثِ النَّبَوِيَّةِ» mein sifat:

q.en: The adjective follows the noun in:
q.ur: Sifat kis cheez mein ism ki pairvi karti hai?
Sifat chunein: هَذا قِطارٌ ___
«الكِتابِ المُبينِ» ka matlab:

intro.en: Practise writing your own opinion in Arabic. Give your view on short statements, write a short topic on Arabic as a world language, and describe how you learn a language that is not your own.
intro.ur: Apni raaye Arabi mein likhne ki mashq. Mukhtasar bayanaat par apni raaye likhein, Arabi aalmi zubaan par mazmoon likhein aur batayein ke aap ghair zubaan kaise seekhte hain.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى كِتابَةِ رَأْيِكَ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ: اِكْتُبْ رَأْيَكَ في عِباراتٍ قَصيرَةٍ، وَاكْتُبْ مَوْضوعاً قَصيراً عَنِ العَرَبِيَّةِ لُغَةً عالَمِيَّةً، وَصِفْ كَيْفَ تَتَعَلَّمُ لُغَةً لَيْسَتْ لُغَتَكَ.

q.ur: «هَلْ تُوافِقُ أَمْ لا؟» kya poochta hai?
q.ar: ماذا نَسْأَلُ بِقَوْلِنا «هَلْ تُوافِقُ أَمْ لا؟»

q.ur: «اُكْتُبْ رَأْيَكَ» ka matlab:
«لُغَةٌ واحِدَةٌ» ka matlab:
«مَوْضوع» ka matlab:

intro.en: The connecting hamzah is written as a plain alif, whether it is pronounced or not, with any vowel. Example: اِسْمٌ (not إِسْمٌ), اِمْرَأَةٌ، اُدْخُلْ. Also, the alif of ال is dropped when the lam of a preposition comes before it: لِلْمُلْكِ.
intro.ur: Hamzat-ul-wasl sada alif ke taur par likha jata hai, chahe bola jaye ya na bola jaye, aur chahe uski harkat kuch bhi ho. Misal: اِسْمٌ (إِسْمٌ nahin), اِمْرَأَةٌ، اُدْخُلْ. Jab ال se pehle lam-e-jar aaye to ال ka alif gir jata hai: لِلْمُلْكِ.
intro.ar: تُكْتَبُ هَمْزَةُ الوَصْلِ أَلِفاً بِلا هَمْزَةٍ سَواءٌ نُطِقَتْ أَمْ لا: اِسْمٌ، اِمْرَأَةٌ، اُدْخُلْ. وَتُحْذَفُ أَلِفُ «ال» إِذا سَبَقَتْها لامُ الجَرِّ: لِلْمُلْكِ.

q.ur: 'Naam' ki durust imla kaun si hai?
«ما إِسْمُكَ؟» ki durust shakl:

q.en: What happens to the alif of ال after the preposition لِ?
q.ur: لِ ke baad ال ke alif ka kya hota hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لِأَلِفِ «ال» بَعْدَ لامِ الجَرِّ؟

q.ur: 'Andar aao' ki durust imla:
q.ar: ما الكِتابَةُ الصَّحيحَةُ لِفِعْلِ الأَمْرِ مِنْ «دَخَلَ»؟
